2026-11-01.title: The Lord Remembers
2026-11-01.verse: He gives food to his faithful followers; he always remembers his covenant.
2026-11-01.observation: I don’t always have the best memory. I can remember some things, but others are gone as quickly as they cross my mind. I have a daughter that is not like that at all. She can remember things so clearly. But even she needs something to start the memory. If you give her a place or a circumstance, she can usually pull up the rest. Isn’t it great that God is even better than that?! He doesn’t have to be reminded about His promises or told that He said He would take care of us. Even before we have a problem, God has already planned the next step. Therefore, truly believing this in our hearts can bring us great joy. We realize that God is always ahead of all our issues and He remembers His faithfulness toward us.
2026-11-01.application: Rest in the promise that God will never forget you.
2026-11-01.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being so very faithful toward us.

2026-11-02.title: One of the Hardest Tools of Discipleship
2026-11-02.verse: It goes well for the one who generously lends money and conducts his business honestly.
2026-11-02.observation: It is generally not difficult to be inspired to know God more. It is generally not difficult to grow in freedom by doing life with others and letting our lives be a witness. It is not too difficult to give of ourselves to others and serve as Jesus Christ served others. However, one of the most difficult things to do is to be generous with our money. It is such a difficult concept that is so often pushed against that modern day pastors have started using other phrases like our “resource,” our “provision,” or our “gifts” as a way to approach the topic. There are many reasons for this but one of the reasons is because nothing fights for our hearts quite like our finances. We try to get from our money what only God can provide. As a child of God, our significance, security, and acceptance come from Him. However, we try to use money to buy things we don’t want to impress people we don’t like so they will give us what only God can give. So, take a moment and think about it. The best way to know the condition of your heart is your willingness to give it away without any visible return. Would you give to someone if they never knew? Would you be faithful to give to God’s church if no one noticed?
2026-11-02.application: Do you faithfully give to your local church? Honestly examine your heart and think about why or why not.
2026-11-02.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for growing us in the hard areas.

2026-11-03.title: Everyone Has A Place In God’s Family
2026-11-03.verse: He makes the barren woman of the family a happy mother of children. Praise the Lord.
2026-11-03.observation: I have always dreamed of pastoring a church that was not predominantly young or old, white or black, male or female. I have always dreamed of pastoring a church that looked like Heaven. This also goes for those who do not have an upbringing or a current situation that mirrors everyone else. This can be difficult because it is hard-wired into us all to go into every room looking for people like us. It gives us a sense of calm and that we are not alone. In the Kingdom of God, we have the opportunity to create environments like this. The doorway is salvation. Once we establish Jesus as our King, we can begin to grow from there. Our rallying point can be something greater than our melanin, background, or cultural status. It can be that we are all saved by the grace of God. When we do this, everyone can find their place in God’s family.
2026-11-03.application: How are you making room for people different than you in God’s House?
2026-11-03.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always making room for us.

2026-11-04.title: A Continual Reminder
2026-11-04.verse: who turned a rock into a pool of water, a hard rock into springs of water.
2026-11-04.observation: In many of the songs in the Bible, we find a consistent reminder of when God brought the nation of Israel water in the desert. Moses hit a rock and enough water flowed out to take care of all the needs for an entire nation! It’s no wonder they consistently remember this and continue to point to this moment as a sign that God will always make a way. Do you have a time in your life when God did something amazing? I do. I can remember a time when I desperately needed a job and it had to be for a certain amount of money or I could not support my family. In one meeting, the Lord not only made a way for me to get a job but it was within my skillset, the hours were exactly what I needed, and the money was what I needed! I know the Lord did it because the guy said he had been praying and felt what he offered was what the Lord had put on his heart. I consistently think back on this when all feels lost and I don’t know how the Lord will work it out. If He can bring water from a rock, He is able. If He can bring a job that fits exactly what I needed in a moment of desperation, He is able. God is able in your life, too.
2026-11-04.application: Find a moment in your life when God did something awesome. Hold on to it and point to it as a sign of God’s faithfulness.
2026-11-04.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for doing the impossible in our lives.

2026-11-05.title: You Become Who You Hang Around
2026-11-05.verse: Those who make them will end up like them, as will everyone who trusts in them. O Israel, trust in the Lord. He is their deliverer and protector. O family of Aaron, trust in the Lord. He is their deliverer and protector.
2026-11-05.observation: Today’s song talks about how those who worship these dead and worthless idols become just like them. Worshiping a dead god only makes you dead on the inside. However, we should put our trust in the Lord because He is far from dead. He is alive and active in our world and in our lives. Therefore, we should spend time in His presence, in worship, in reading His Word, and in reflection about His goodness. People have a tendency to begin imitating what we spend time around. It’s part of our nature. If we hang around the dead things of the world, we will begin acting in that way. But, if we spend time with the Lord and reading about His character in His Word, we will begin reflecting His nature and character as well.
2026-11-05.application: Spend time reflecting on the Lord today and never see that as wasted time. You are slowly learning how to become more like Christ.
2026-11-05.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always welcoming us into Your presence.

2026-11-06.title: Slaves to Servants to Sons
2026-11-06.verse: Yes, Lord! I am indeed your servant; I am your servant, the son of your female servant. You saved me from death.
2026-11-06.observation: Today’s song reminded me of a statement made by a fictional character called Screwtape. *The Screwtape Letters* is a fictional book by C.S. Lewis to discuss how spiritual warfare works itself out in the daily life of a Christian. In this creative narrative, Screwtape is a senior demon writing correspondence back and forth to a junior apprentice. In one such letter he says that the devil’s job is to trick people into thinking they are servants but he really creates slaves. However, God takes slaves, makes them servants so they can become sons. It’s a powerful idea of how the process of discipleship happens in our lives. When we begin to follow Jesus, we do so as a servant and following what His Word says because we want to serve the Lord. As we continue to follow, we begin to slowly understand the reasoning why and it goes from worshipful obligation to understanding cooperation. God’s goal is nothing less than our complete freedom.
2026-11-06.application: Think about why God’s Word tells us to do and not to do some things. It is for our benefit. Do we trust God enough to obey until we understand?
2026-11-06.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for leading us more and more each day.

2026-11-07.title: The Power of Love
2026-11-07.verse: For his loyal love towers over us, and the Lord’s faithfulness endures. Praise the Lord.
2026-11-07.observation: Today’s song is the shortest in the book of Psalms. In my imagination, I have wondered if this was one of those songs that repeated these lyrics over and over again accompanied by a lot of musical solos. Either way, this song has a powerful point. It says God’s love for us is powerful. Have you ever thought about that? There are many things we have a passing care about. We say we love certain foods. We say we love sports teams. We say we love seasons of the year. However, there are some things or people that we love so much that our love for them compels us to action. We truly love our family. We truly love our closest friends. God’s love for us is not a passive love that fades away with the season. His love is so strong that He was willing to come to Earth, die on our Cross, and rise again so we can have life. That is a powerful force. That same love that kept Him on the Cross is the same love He has for you right now. You have never been more loved than you are right now.
2026-11-07.application: Think about how much the Lord loves you.
2026-11-07.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us even when we do not always love ourselves.

2026-11-08.title: Every Day is God’s Day
2026-11-08.verse: This is the Lord’s work. We consider it amazing! This is the day the Lord has brought about. We will be happy and rejoice in it.
2026-11-08.observation: I heard a guy once say that he divided his week up into three sections: his boss’s days, his family’s day, and the Lord’s day. He worked five days a week and said those days belonged to his company. He gave his greatest strength to those days so he could provide for his family. Not only that, but he still saw his family in the evenings and spent quality time with them. Likewise, he just knew that those days were primary for earning. Then, he had one day off from work, and he gave that to his family. He reserved open time to pursue interests with them. Then, every Sunday he called the Lord’s day. Here was the catch: he said that those were only available to him because they were all truly the Lord’s days. He was given strength to work, a family to bless, and a church to worship. He saw it all as gifts from the Lord. How blessed would we be if we truly realized that, while we say one day is for this or that person, all days are truly from the Lord. Therefore, we can rejoice in every day.
2026-11-08.application: Start your day with thankfulness to the Lord and watch how the rest of the week goes.
2026-11-08.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for all Your many blessings every single day.

2026-11-09.title: If We Could Only See
2026-11-09.verse: Open my eyes so I can truly see the marvelous things in your law.
2026-11-09.observation: As a pastor, I think one of my biggest tasks is to get people to read their Bibles. Almost anything people say they want or need in life ultimately comes back, in part, to whether or not they are getting to know God more through reading His Word. God’s Word is where He reveals Himself to us. God’s Word is where He shows us the way. His Word gives us insight for life, and tells us the wonderful truth of salvation. However, there is always a massive hindrance to reading God’s Word and I think that is by design. Some of the greatest spiritual warfare will come as we determine to read God’s Word. We have a spiritual enemy who does not want us to read God’s Word. But, if we could only see how wonderful God’s Word truly is, we would be hungry to know God’s Word more. Every time we read God’s Word, it is like the voice of God whispering fresh wind over our souls.
2026-11-09.application: Make a plan to read God’s Word slowly every day. Let the truth of God slowly pour over your soul.
2026-11-09.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for speaking to us through Your Word.

2026-11-10.title: Take Your Burdens to the Lord
2026-11-10.verse: A song of ascents. In my distress I cried out to the Lord and he answered me.
2026-11-10.observation: Today’s song gives us a great reminder that we do not have to carry our burdens alone. I love an old song that used to say, “Take your burdens to the Lord and leave it there.” The second half of that phrase is important. Many times, we will take our burdens to the Lord and then take the responsibility of them with us back out of the room. I’m not saying we do not still have to deal with the issue. We cannot give up on our responsibilities. However, we do not have to carry the weight of fixing it. We do our best and trust that the Lord is doing all that we cannot see.
2026-11-10.application: Today, take your burdens to the Lord and leave it there.
2026-11-10.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being willing to walk with us through every season of life.

2026-11-11.title: Where Do You Go When It Matters?
2026-11-11.verse: A song of ascents. I look up toward the hills. From where does my help come? My help comes from the Lord, the Creator of heaven and earth. May he not allow your foot to slip. May your Protector not sleep.
2026-11-11.observation: When my girls were little, they both went through a season where they wanted to do everything themselves. They didn’t want any help. One of my daughters would get so angry if we tried to do anything for her and yell out, “Me do it. Me do it.” She was determined to be self-sufficient. My wife and I had to struggle not to laugh at this little girl who was completely reliant on us yet thought she was completely independent. Also, all the independence would melt away as soon as she would get hurt. I often wonder if God looks at us like that. We live in His world, breathe His air, and experience His goodness all around us. Yet, we try to act like we can do anything independently of Him. What matters even more is what happens when something goes wrong. Where do we truly turn? God invites us to look to Him. He will hold us up. He will help us walk through any dark valley. He is already with us more than we realize.
2026-11-11.application: Get God involved before you have to. He’s already there.
2026-11-11.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for walking with us and having more kindness than we can imagine.

2026-11-12.title: The Joy of Community Worship
2026-11-12.verse:
I was glad because they said to me,  
'We will go to the Lord’s temple.'
2026-11-12.observation: We live in a culture where we can do almost anything online. This possibility has made many things better. I'll admit that I would rather shop online. I would rather order food online. I would rather do research online than go to a library. However, some things cannot be replicated. One of these is the timeless joy of worshiping God in a spiritual community. The church is intended to be an outpost of Heaven in the world. We are people who have been radically changed by the mercy of Jesus. When we gather, we become a glimpse of Heaven. Our primary goal is to worship the Lord together. This cannot be replicated online. Therefore, one of the greatest joys in our lives should be to gather together and worship the Lord. Because of this, the enemy will do everything to destroy our church communities. We have to fight for unity, fight for forgiveness, and fight to stay together every day. We can only do this if we do it together.
2026-11-12.application: Make consistent community worship with your spiritual family a priority.
2026-11-12.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for the opportunity to do life with other people on the same journey toward spiritual maturity.

2026-11-13.title: The Honor of the King's Help
2026-11-13.verse: I look up toward you, the one enthroned in heaven.
2026-11-13.observation: There is an old phrase: familiarity breeds contempt. This means that what we experience regularly, we begin to take for granted. Because of this, marketing companies intentionally make products available only at certain times of the year. There was a time when you could only get certain lattes around the holiday season. It was not because there was a shortage. They were trying to create demand by creating a shortage in supply. While this can be a good marketing strategy, it also shows a problem many Christians have. Because God is always close, we can begin to take Him for granted. We can begin to think of God as common, or only a little better than us. The reality is that we are extremely blessed to be able to look up to God and receive His blessings. He is a great King, and maybe the greatest thing is that He is also good. So, the next time you pray and talk to Him, think about the fact that you have more access to the King of the Universe than you do to your local political leader. You are blessed beyond measure.
2026-11-13.application: Take a moment and think about how great the Lord is, and how He shows it through His goodness.
2026-11-13.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for the honor of being able to talk to You so freely.

2026-11-14.title: The Lord Makes the Difference
2026-11-14.verse: ‘If the LORD had not been on our side’ – let Israel say this! – ‘if the LORD had not been on our side, when men attacked us, they would have swallowed us alive, when their anger raged against us.’
2026-11-14.observation: There have been many seasons in my life that I moved through so quickly that I never stepped back to notice how much help it took to get through them. I once thought it would be a good idea to host a murder mystery theater. It was a lot of work, and when it was over, I was proud of how it turned out. Then, after reflecting, I realized the credit did not belong to me alone. So many people had put in a lot of effort to make it as great as it was. Without them, it never would have happened. This did not take away the joy of the victory; it gave me even more gratitude as I realized how much other people had shared in the moment. I wonder how many times we come through a difficult situation proud of how we handled it. This is not a bad thing, but I wonder how much clarity we would gain if we realized that we were not alone in it. God was the one doing the heavy lifting, doing the impossible, and sustaining us along the way. This should fill us with gratitude that we have never been alone. He is always with us.
2026-11-14.application: Take a moment and realize you have never had to go it alone. The Lord is always with you.
2026-11-14.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being close and doing more than we realize.

2026-11-16.title: Trust is Our Superpower
2026-11-16.verse: Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion; it cannot be upended and will endure forever. As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people, now and forevermore.
2026-11-16.observation: Have you ever thought about how God never asks us to do great things? He asks us to trust Him to accomplish His will in and through us. He decides what is great and accomplishes it through our lives. He asks for our cooperation, best effort, and trust. God does the impossible. Something about this can take so much pressure off our hearts. Our best weapon in life is not how independent we can be, how hard we can work, or how many gifts we have. Our best weapon is how closely we can walk with the Lord, how much of our best effort we can give, and how much we can trust the Lord. We are commanded by God to do our best, and He does the rest. This is also true when it comes to deciding what to call "great." Many of us look to culture and the world to decide what greatness should be. But when we go to God's Word, we realize He measures greatness in very different ways. As we place our trust in Him, He defines greatness and then leads us in that direction.
2026-11-16.application: Take a moment and test your "trust meter." Do you trust the Lord to work things out as you do your best?
2026-11-16.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always doing more than we realize at the time.

2026-11-17.title: Hard Seasons Can Bring Joyful Harvest
2026-11-17.verse: Those who shed tears as they plant will shout for joy when they reap the harvest. The one who weeps as he walks along, carrying his bag of seed, will certainly come in with a shout of joy, carrying his sheaves of grain.
2026-11-17.observation: A long time ago, I ran a marathon. Even though it was a long time ago, I remember two things most about the entire experience. The first is one evening when I had to run 8 miles in the snow and ice. It was a terrible experience, but I had to train. I remember being so miserable and wanting to just quit so badly. The other memory is crossing the finish line and immediately realizing it was worth it. In life, we will go through many difficult seasons. There will be times when we will be miserable and just want to quit. Those are the moments when we need to lean into the Lord more than ever and refuse to stop following Him. The good news is that those days may seem like they last forever, but they do eventually end. The daylight comes, and we pass from that season into another. When it does, we will say it was worth it.
2026-11-17.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for walking with us through every dark season.

2026-11-18.title: It's All About the Lord
2026-11-18.verse: If the LORD does not build a house, then those who build it work in vain. If the LORD does not guard a city, then the watchman stands guard in vain. It is vain for you to rise early, come home late, and work so hard for your food. Yes, he can provide for those whom he loves even when they sleep. Yes, sons are a gift from the LORD, the fruit of the womb is a reward.
2026-11-18.observation: When I was a teenager, I worked at McDonald's. The most popular sandwich was the Big Mac. This sandwich was made differently from the others, but what set it apart was the secret sauce called Mac Sauce. People would order the Big Mac several different ways, but they always kept the Mac Sauce. One time, not long after I started working, I forgot to put the Mac Sauce on a burger. The customer was less than pleased. I still remember them saying, "That burger is not worth eating without the sauce. The sauce is what makes it special." Life is a lot like that. We try to do life without God. If we do, we quickly realize that life just isn't the same. It is the Lord who makes life special. He is the one who makes our effort worth it. He builds our lives one day at a time.
2026-11-18.application: Be mindful of the Lord in everything you do today.
2026-11-18.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for making life worth living.

2026-11-19.title: Loyalty Is Rewarded
2026-11-19.verse: How blessed is every one of the LORD’s loyal followers, each one who keeps his commands! You will eat what you worked so hard to grow. You will be blessed and secure.
2026-11-19.observation: When I was young, I worked for Verizon Wireless. It was a lot of fun working for a cell phone company at the time. Phones were becoming a bigger part of everyday life, and people were finding new ways to stay connected with their friends and family. To keep their products appealing, Verizon was always offering great deals to new customers. The challenge was that existing customers would come in and ask for the same deal. When we said this was only for new customers, existing customers would say that was unfair and that they were not being rewarded for their loyalty to the company. Sometimes people would even get so frustrated that they would demand to cancel their service. When this happened, we were trained to remind them of all the services they had already received as an existing customer. This usually stopped all the complaining. The customer had become so upset over a momentary deal that they forgot how much value they were already receiving. I wonder how often we do that as Christians. We see a young Christian experiencing the goodness of God in a fresh way and wonder why we are not receiving such joy. We almost think God is doing something in them and has forgotten about us. However, only a moment of thinking about how good God is to us should stop us in our tracks. God is good, and He is more faithful to us than we can imagine. As we continue to stay loyal to Him, He continues to lead and guide us every day.
2026-11-19.application: Think about the journey you have had with the Lord up till now. Take a few minutes and celebrate His goodness.
2026-11-19.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for the opportunity to know You and walk with You.

2026-11-20.title: Down But Not Defeated
2026-11-20.verse: Since my youth they have often attacked me, but they have not defeated me. The plowers plowed my back; they made their furrows long. The LORD is just; he cut the ropes of the wicked.
2026-11-20.observation: There is a disastrous theology out there that says if you believe and trust the Lord enough, you will never go through tough times. Whoever believes this has likely never read much of the Bible. God's Word is full of people who went through devastating situations. In spite of it all, the Lord was with them and did wonderful things out of terrible messes. Sometimes, the dark is the best place to see the light. When you're outside on a beautiful summer day, it is difficult to see the light of a flashlight. However, if you are outside in the middle of winter on a dark night, the flashlight shines for all to see. Often, the best place to see God's goodness is when you need it most. So, while we do not ever wish for bad things or desire to go through trials, we no longer think of them the same way. We realize they are never without hope. The Lord is there.
2026-11-20.application: If you are going through a dark season, take a moment to think about the Lord.
2026-11-20.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being with me in this dark season.

2026-11-21.title: Desire the Lord
2026-11-21.verse: But you are willing to forgive, so that you might be honored. I rely on the LORD, I rely on him with my whole being; I wait for his assuring word. I yearn for the Lord, more than watchmen do for the morning, yes, more than watchmen do for the morning.
2026-11-21.observation: My wife and I love to drink coffee. We go exploring and go to coffee shops all the time. We get excited about experiencing new types of coffee and new places. It adds a fun element to our travels. Because we go into a new city looking for unique and fun coffee shops, we usually find at least one. We have realized we usually find what we are looking for. I was talking with someone the other day who said they hated everything about traveling. I told them they needed to find something like our coffee explorations to add excitement to their travel. When you look forward to doing something, it creates a sense of expectation and joy. I think our desire for the Lord transforms our church experiences. When you go to church, do you desire to see the Lord? If not, you can go to church and almost dare people to do something that impacts your life. Most of the time, you'll probably leave disappointed. However, when you go to church, say, "Lord, today I desire to know You more. Let me see You in a fresh way today." Watch what happens. Not only will you see the Lord differently that day, but you will also find fresh excitement in going to the Lord's House. What you desire, you will find.
2026-11-21.application: Make a point to ask the Lord to show Himself to you in a fresh way this Sunday.
2026-11-21.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for showing Yourself to us in fresh ways every morning.

2026-11-22.title: The Beauty of Contentment
2026-11-22.verse: O LORD, my heart is not proud, nor do I have a haughty look. I do not have great aspirations, or concern myself with things that are beyond me. Indeed I am composed and quiet, like a young child carried by its mother; I am content like the young child I carry.
2026-11-22.observation: I used to think that contentment meant settling for less. I thought it meant becoming okay with not having what you want and being okay with giving up. This is nothing close to true contentment. True contentment is taking an honest look at where you are and being thankful. It does not mean giving up on the future. It does not mean settling for less than what you desire. Those are different issues for a different time. True contentment is looking around and finding reasons to be thankful for what you have, where you are, and who you are with. The quickest way to lose contentment is to compare yourself with someone else. The quickest way to find contentment is to be thankful for everything you have. Try it and watch what happens.
2026-11-22.application: Write down ten things in your life, and find a new way of looking at each one that brings joy.
2026-11-22.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us more than we deserve.

2026-11-23.title: Have a Meeting with God
2026-11-23.verse: Let us go to his dwelling place! Let us worship before his footstool! Ascend, O LORD, to your resting place, you and the ark of your strength! May your priests be clothed with integrity! May your loyal followers shout for joy!
2026-11-23.observation: It is the honor of my life to be a pastor. It is a joy to walk with people as they learn to find their footing in walking with the Lord. Part of my honor is to meet with people and check in on their soul. This is not always easy. Everyone is always fighting a private battle that no one else can see. I prepare for these meetings, drive to the location, and spend time with that person. There is preparation, thought, and intentionality involved. If we do this when meeting with people, I wonder how much more we should do this with the Lord. The King of kings is so present and active in our lives that we can easily forget the honor of being able to talk with Him. I’m not advocating for a formal, stiff relationship. I’m asking what it would look like for us to make an appointment with God and think of it as an appointment with someone who matters. For the next week, try it out. Make a daily appointment with God and put it on your calendar. Don’t miss it. Come in prepared to clear your mind of everything else and spend time with Him. I bet it will become your favorite time of the day.
2026-11-23.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for the opportunity to spend time with You every day.

2026-11-24.title: The Beauty of Unity
2026-11-24.verse: Look! How good and how pleasant it is when brothers live together! It is like fine oil poured on the head which flows down the beard – Aaron’s beard, and then flows down his garments.
2026-11-24.observation: My wife and I once decided we wanted to go kayaking. When going up to the counter to rent two kayaks, we noticed one that sat two people. The lady warned us repeatedly not to rent it. She said it was very hard to stay in sync and usually leads to a bad day. We assured her we would be just fine and rented it anyway. By the end of the day, we realized we actually have very different opinions about how to lead and follow on a kayak. We understood what that lady was trying to warn us about. Staying unified is hard with anything from paddling down a river to being part of an organization. Unity does not happen by accident. If you have ever noticed any group of two or more people that appears to be on the same page, someone is working hard behind the scenes to keep it that way. Today’s song says it is a joy when people can live together in unity. Here is a hard question to consider today: In the relationships around you, are you working hard to find common ground or working hard to only push your own agenda? Are you making it hard to dwell together in unity? Unity does not mean we agree on everything. It means we align on the essentials and give grace in the non-essentials. Where do you need to start giving grace?
2026-11-24.application: Think about your most important relationships. Where do you need to start giving grace? Where do you need to ask for grace?
2026-11-24.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us the opportunity to find unity together.

2026-11-25.title: Be Mindful of the Lord at All Times
2026-11-25.verse: Attention! Praise the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, who serve in the LORD’s temple during the night.
2026-11-25.observation: I knew a guy once who worked third shift for over forty years! He told me that he could tell if someone was going to make it on third shift within the first month. He said your body had to adjust. If it couldn’t, you wouldn’t make it. He said you also had to be able to keep away the sadness during the night. His opinion was that the human body was not accustomed to staying up all night, so it would think something was wrong. You had to train your mind to stay active and alert. I can definitely relate to what he is saying. This may not be true about you, but the later it gets, the more my anxiety increases. I begin to feel as though something is not quite right and that more is wrong than is probably true. During these times, I usually just need to go to bed, but that is not always possible. In those moments, I have to discipline my mind to think on the Lord and remember His goodness. Today’s song is saying the same to the night watchmen. They are told to pay attention and to praise the Lord on their night watches. This is a good reminder for us. When we get inside our own heads too much or get busy going about our daily obligations, we should never get far from remembering the Lord. Let’s allow His goodness to shine through our distractions and mental blocks.
2026-11-25.application: Where and when do you need to increase your focus on the Lord?
2026-11-25.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being with us in every situation.

2026-11-26.title: God Does What He Pleases
2026-11-26.verse: Yes, I know the LORD is great, and our Lord is superior to all gods. He does whatever he pleases in heaven and on earth, in the seas and all the ocean depths.
2026-11-26.observation: When my girls were little, we did something on their birthday called “queen for the day.” This meant that we did whatever they wanted for an entire day. This was a double-edged sword. On one side, it was great because they were able to celebrate in any way they wanted. On the other side, the rest of the family did not always enjoy it because they rarely asked if we were interested in doing what they wanted. Of course, that was part of the gift of being queen for the day. We played along with whatever they wanted. Today’s song says God does whatever He wants. This means God is “King for the day” every day. When you think about it, this is the best news we could hear. God is completely good, completely kind, and for us in more ways than we can realize. Therefore, He never does anything other than what is meant for His glory and our ultimate good. So, remember that God is ridiculously in charge today. That’s the best news we could hear.
2026-11-26.application: Celebrate that our God is in control.
2026-11-26.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for not only being in control but also loving us the way You do.

2026-11-27.title: God is Loyal
2026-11-27.verse: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loyal love endures.
2026-11-27.observation: Have you ever trusted something so much that, when it failed, you felt as though the bottom dropped out from under you and you started questioning your life choices? I had this happen with a car. As a teenager, I went through a series of unreliable vehicles. The only thing they all had in common was that they were just about dead when I bought them. In my early twenties, I finally had the money to buy a dependable car. For the first time in my driving life, I no longer wondered if I could get where I was going. For a few years, I celebrated this car and rested in the knowledge that it was dependable. Then one day it broke down. I was shocked. What happened? This car was supposed to be solid and dependable. Well, it turns out that nothing in this life is dependable. That's why it is such a blessing to remember that God is not "of this world." He created all things. He stands outside of space and time and is greater than we can imagine. God is loyal and loves us. His love never falters or fails. God never changes His mind about loving us. Even when we are unfaithful to Him, He is always faithful. So, you never have to wake up in the morning and wonder if God's grace is dependable. There will never be a day when you find that God's love has broken down and you have to reexamine your life choices. His love is loyal and dependable.
2026-11-27.application: Take a moment and think about the fact that you have never had a single day when God did not love you.
2026-11-27.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for Your faithful love that lasts forever.

2026-11-28.title: Remembering While Mourning
2026-11-28.verse: By the rivers of Babylon we sit down and weep when we remember Zion. On the poplars in her midst we hang our harps, for there our captors ask us to compose songs; those who mock us demand that we be happy, saying: ‘Sing for us a song about Zion!’ How can we sing a song to the LORD in a foreign land? If I forget you, O Jerusalem, may my right hand be crippled.
2026-11-28.observation: Today's song is devastating. It paints a picture of those who were exiled after Babylon destroyed Jerusalem. The author is mourning the loss of his freedom, his home, and everything he held close. While mourning, he is also being criticized by those surrounding him. It is not a sin to mourn. We can trust God and still hurt because we've lost something we love. Grief shows how much we loved something. Grief is love continuing. However, the songwriter shows us what to do with our grief. During the depths of our grief, we remember the Lord. We remember who He is and that He is with us, even in our darkest moments. In the songwriter's case, the devastation came because the nation had turned its back on God. Something amazing about God is that even if we are grieving because of the consequences of our sin, He is still with us. He loves us, despite our imperfections. What a truly merciful God we serve.
2026-11-28.application: No matter the battle you are facing, remember you do not walk this path alone. The Lord is there.
2026-11-28.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for walking with us through every dark valley.

2026-11-29.title: The Lord Sees Us
2026-11-29.verse: Let them sing about the LORD’s deeds, for the LORD’s splendor is magnificent. Though the LORD is exalted, he looks after the lowly, and from far away humbles the proud.
2026-11-29.observation: Have you ever heard the phrase “Misery loves company”? This phrase means that people who are down usually bring other people down. Because of this, many people don't like to hang around broken and hurting people. It's not because they don't love these people; they simply find it hard to sustain. One of the things I love about the Lord is that our current state of mind does not hinder Him from coming close to us. I love the songwriter's statement, “he looks after the lowly.” This paints the picture of the Lord coming close and bringing comfort to the wounded. What an honor to serve the Lord who is greater than we can imagine and also sees to the needs of the lowest among us! He walks with the lowly and looks after them in their struggle. He keeps us from dangers we will never know and guards our hearts from darkness that will never come close. We serve an amazing God.
2026-11-29.application: Celebrate the Lord's faithfulness in protecting us from things we will never even know about.
2026-11-29.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for all Your unknown miracles.
